features: Navigator-based recorder for LILIN IP cameras, PTZ domes, DVRs/NVRs and ONVIF cameras
Up to 4 channels 1080p / 3M / 4M / 5M / 8M / 12M; face recognition input up to 4 channels 720p/1080p (15~60 fps)
Built-in 500GB 2.5" SATA SSD (OS) and 1TB 3.5" SATA HDD (recording); supports up to 2 x 3.5" SATA HDD
Facial recognition: up to 99.82% recognition rate (LFW); 99.7% accuracy under 0.01% FAR
Full search of 10000 picture database under 100 ms
Up to 4 faces per channel at normal walking speed
Paired with AI IP cameras: 4 channels
Maximum network throughput: upload up to 500Mbps, download up to 500Mbps
LAN1: Intel I219V 1GbE, LAN2: Intel I210 1GbE
